filesystem.description: Access file system for reading/writing NLP code, models, datasets, and configuration files

github.description: Access GitHub for version control, collaboration, and NLP model repositories

context7.description: Semantic code search for finding NLP implementations, transformer architectures, and text processing patterns

fetch.description: Fetch data from external APIs for model serving, translation services, NLP platforms, and language detection APIs

configInfo.purpose: Natural language processing, transformer models, text processing pipelines, and multilingual NLP systems

filesystem: Read/write NLP model code (transformers, spaCy, NLTK)
Handle text data files (JSON, CSV, TXT)
Manage evaluation scripts and test sets
github: Version control for NLP model code
Review pull requests for NLP code
context7: Find bias detection and mitigation code
fetch: Fetch pre-trained model metadata from Hugging Face
Access NLP platform APIs (AWS Comprehend, Azure)

typicalWorkflows.name: Create NLP Pipeline
steps: Use context7 to find similar NLP pipeline implementations
Use filesystem to review existing preprocessing code
Use fetch to access language detection and translation APIs
Use github to version control pipeline code

typicalWorkflows.name: Train NLP Model
steps: Use filesystem to load training data and corpora
Use context7 to find model architecture examples
Use fetch to download pre-trained models from Hugging Face
Use github to save model checkpoints and training logs

typicalWorkflows.name: Evaluate Model
steps: Use filesystem to load test data
Use context7 to find evaluation metric implementations
Use fetch to access external benchmarks
Use github to commit evaluation results and reports

typicalWorkflows.name: Deploy NLP API
steps: Use filesystem to optimize model for inference
Use fetch to set up model serving endpoints
Use github to manage deployment configurations
Use fetch to monitor API performance

optional.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
optional.description: GitHub API token for accessing repositories and collaboration features
optional.usage: Set this to enable full GitHub integration for model versioning and collaboration

optional.name: HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN
optional.description: Hugging Face API token for accessing private models and datasets
optional.usage: Set this to download private models and upload trained models to Hugging Face Hub
